accepted_title: 创新药还有机会吗，42元的恒瑞医药贵不贵？
applies_to: price-led notes whose headline explicitly asks whether a quoted share price is expensive, cheap, justified, overvalued or undervalued
scope_note: This is one Human-calibrated structure for price-led notes, not a global Xiaohongshu template. Other archetypes may use different argument spines when their reader tension is not price-led.
must_survive_in_planner_prompt: 当前隐含预期优先于作者自己的基准模型
要求回报是第二层问题
研究里查到的数字不等于文章里都要出现
不要按创新药、授权、现金流、估值的研报目录顺序平铺
must_survive_failure_modes: 按研究报告顺序写成创新药→License-out→现金流→估值，导致价格问题在中段消失
开头连续塞入三年、10%回报、30倍PE等未解释模型参数
内部基准模型结果在读者看到输入前提前出现
为了显得简洁而压掉因果链，制造似是而非的财经句子
把所有深度研究成果都塞进文章，导致信息多但主线变弱
rejected_examples: 先要看这16%的创新药增长，最后能不能长成126亿元利润。
高基数以后还能剩多少。
License-out已经赚到真钱，但还不能当成年金
而我目前这套基准假设里，2029年利润大约只有
review_rule: For a price-led note, do not compress the Research into a shorter research report. Reconstruct what the quoted price already believes, compare that with what the company has actually proved, quantify the gap, and only then introduce a required-return hurdle as a second-layer diagnostic. Do not apply this spine to unrelated archetypes by default.
